info.description: The AI-ready data layer for sophisticated investors: SEC filing data, macro data, factor data, and repeatable investment analysis through one API. The current production API host is https://api.secapi.ai. The intended future TUROS API host is https://api.turos.app, but it is not listed as a server until host parity is verified.

Header metadata (manager, quarter, totals, previous filing id, SEC source URL) plus value-ranked holdings rows. Holdings identify securities by issuer-key slug and symbol; CUSIP/ISIN are never emitted. Each holding reports `amount` (the figure the filing carried in sshPrnamt) alongside `amountType`: "SH" when that figure is a share count, "PRN" when it is a principal/face amount on a convertible note or debt instrument, and null when the filing carried no recognizable flag. `shares` is populated only where amountType is not PRN, so a principal amount does not reach you under a share-count field. Do not label or sum `amount` as shares without checking `amountType`.

get.description: New/closed/increased/decreased positions with share and value deltas. Both filings must belong to the same manager.
Reverse-chronological indexed 13F filings (manager, period, filed date, holdings count, total value), cursor-paged and bounded to the last 120 days of filings.

Latest-quarter cross-manager rollup per security: managers holding, totals, quarter-over-quarter share deltas, filer-count change, average portfolio rank, put/call ratio, and top-10 count. Share-denominated fields count long-equity shares only; option legs and PRN (principal-amount) legs are excluded, because a convertible note's face amount is dollars rather than shares. Dual-class share lines under one issuer are summed, so value fields are the cross-class-safe comparison. Non-share fields still count PRN holders: a manager holding only a convertible counts in `managersHolding`, contributes to `totalValueUsd`, and receives a (value-based) portfolio rank. As a result, `totalShares` divided by `managersHolding` is not a meaningful average share count for convertible-heavy issuers, and an issuer held only through debt reports `totalShares` 0 with `managersHolding` above 0. `putCallRatio` is managers with at least one put leg over managers with at least one call leg; it is null when no manager holds calls and 0 when calls exist but puts do not. `managersFiled` and `prevManagersFiled` report distinct filers this quarter versus the prior quarter, so partially filed quarters can be identified.
